title: "Why Right Beliefs About God Matter" 🔥
paragraphs:
"Why Right Beliefs About God Matter" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 What you believe about God shapes your entire life.
👉 But what if your beliefs are not aligned with biblical truth?
Many people say they believe in God, yet their understanding is often based on:

Cultural beliefs passed down through generations.
Religious traditions that sound right but lack biblical support.
Personal feelings instead of the authority of God’s Word.
📖 “My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge.” (Hosea 4:6)
💡 Truth matters because eternity is at stake. Let’s break this down together.

🔥 1. The Truth About God Must Come From Scripture, Not Feelings
What you believe about God must come from His Word alone.

✅ Wrong Belief: “I feel like God would never judge anyone.”
✅ Biblical Truth: God is both loving and just.
📖 “It is appointed for men to die once, and after that comes judgment.” (Hebrews 9:27)

✅ Wrong Belief: “All religions point to the same God.”
✅ Biblical Truth: Jesus Christ is the only way to salvation.
📖 “Jesus said, ‘I am the Way, the Truth, and the Life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.’” (John 14:6)

✅ Wrong Belief: “If I live a good life, God will accept me.”
✅ Biblical Truth: Salvation is by grace alone, through faith alone.
📖 “For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith... not by works, so that no one can boast.” (Ephesians 2:8-9)

🔥 2. Why Right Beliefs Are Essential for Salvation
Believing in the wrong version of God can have eternal consequences.
📖 “For there is one God and one mediator between God and mankind, the man Christ Jesus.” (1 Timothy 2:5)
✅ Believing the True Gospel Means:

Understanding who Jesus is: Fully God, fully man (John 1:1, Colossians 2:9).
Knowing why He died: To pay for the penalty of sin (Romans 5:8).
Trusting in His finished work alone for salvation (1 Corinthians 15:3-4).

🔥 3. Misconceptions About God That Need to Be Debunked
These common lies are leading people away from the truth:

❌ Myth #1: "God is Love, So He Won't Judge Anyone"
✅ Truth: God is both love and just. He must deal with sin.
📖 “Whoever believes in Him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe stands condemned already.” (John 3:18)

❌ Myth #2: "I Believe in God, So I'm Automatically Saved"
✅ Truth: Belief in God's existence alone doesn't save. Even demons believe.
📖 “You believe there is one God. Good! Even the demons believe—and shudder.” (James 2:19)
Salvation comes only through faith in Jesus Christ.

❌ Myth #3: "The Bible Is Just a Collection of Stories"
✅ Truth: The Bible is the Word of God, inspired and infallible.
📖 “All Scripture is God-breathed and useful for teaching, rebuking, correcting, and training in righteousness.” (2 Timothy 3:16)

🔥 4. Why Right Beliefs Produce Right Living
What you believe about God affects how you live.

✅ Right Belief: Jesus is my Savior → Leads to faithfulness and gratitude.
✅ Right Belief: God is holy → Leads to repentance and a desire for purity.
✅ Right Belief: Salvation is by grace → Leads to humility, not pride.
📖 “Be transformed by the renewing of your mind.” (Romans 12:2)

🔥 5. How to Align Your Beliefs with Biblical Truth
Are you ready to let go of half-truths and follow Jesus fully?
✅ Step 1: Examine Your Beliefs.

Do they align with God’s Word, or personal feelings?
✅ Step 2: Go Back to the Bible.

Make Scripture the final authority in your life.
✅ Step 3: Test Every Teaching.
📖 “Test all things; hold fast to what is good.” (1 Thessalonians 5:21)
✅ Step 4: Trust in Christ Alone.
Salvation is not about how you feel—it’s about trusting His finished work.

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 13, 2025 📜
"I reject cultural lies and choose to believe in the God of the Bible. I trust in Jesus Christ alone as my Lord and Savior, and I commit to aligning my life with the truth of His Word."

🔥 THE “TRUTH MATTERS” CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Examine your beliefs in light of Scripture.
✅ Step 2: Share a Bible verse today that reveals God’s truth.
✅ Step 3: Tag 3 friends who need to hear this.

🌌 DON’T SETTLE FOR HALF-TRUTHS – CHOOSE BIBLICAL TRUTH 🌌
📖 “You will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.” (John 8:32)

💡 Your beliefs matter.
Make sure they are grounded in God’s Word—not popular opinions.

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 13, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
I come before You today, seeking truth in Your Word alone. Protect me from deception and help me to build my faith on the solid foundation of Scripture. I trust fully in Jesus Christ, His finished work on the cross, and His resurrection. Transform my mind and help me live according to Your truth.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️
